lines: Children. From the SKY. Seven of them!
Folks come through cracks in the ground. NOT the clouds!
Well. Welcome to the Void, I suppose.
An emergency town meeting. About the sky.
Melanie. {player}. Is this about the slide again?
{player}: Mr. Palmer, the Void needs a water slide.

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: We don't even have a toy store!

lines: This town has plenty of fun already!
The answer is no. Not now. Sometimes the best thing is to wait.
(He winced at "the old slide"...)
Back again? You two are very patient.
{player}: Something green and giggly got out of the Haunted House!
Oh dear. I'll keep an eye on that.
(A cloud slide over the lake, with a toy store on top!)
You waited. You listened. And you came back with something better.
That's what patience is for. YES!

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Mr. Palmer! The Doggie Bill of Rights!

lines: Hm. "Dogs welcome everywhere." "Zoomies in the Market."
Rule one: yes!
Rule two: zoomies in the mornings only.
Well done, Rex. You listened to everybody. Like a good mayor.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Mr. Palmer! The Doggie Bill of Rights!

lines: Hm. "Dogs welcome everywhere." "Bubble baths for dogs."
Rule one: yes!
Rule two: yes, on Tuesdays.
Well done, Rex. You listened to everybody. Like a good mayor.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Mr. Palmer! The Doggie Bill of Rights!

lines: Hm. "Dogs welcome everywhere." "Sniff everything."
Rule one: yes!
Rule two: yes. But not my sandwiches.
Well done, Rex. You listened to everybody. Like a good mayor.
Ah, {player}. I was hoping you'd come.
Something's not right in the far field. My watch runs backwards out there.
And peek at the old iron gate in the woods. Just peek!
Thank you, {player}.
Oh, hello, {player}!
{player}: Rex wants to be mayor! Here are his ideas.
Lovely ideas. Really lovely.
But the answer is no. Not this year.
{player}: Oh. Rex is going to be sad.
Tell him: a good mayor is patient, and listens first.
And he's already started! He asked everyone. Even Rook!
I'll put Bramble's flowers up right away!
(The curtains are closed.)
(OFFICE HOURS: MORNING TILL TEATIME)

rotate: Still listening to everybody? Me too!

lines: Hello! I'm Mr. Palmer, mayor of the Void.
My window is always open!

rotate: Busy! Somebody moved the whole market!
Being mayor is mostly listening. And signing.
No, the portal is NOT a swimming pool!
